title.zh: 【Canton 上代币化证券交易平台 TSV 计划最早于 11 月 2 日启动 CNTN 代币化股票交易】
title.en: 【Canton 上代币化证券交易平台 TSV 计划最早于 11 月 2 日启动 CNTN 代币化股票交易】

current_state.zh: Canton Strategic Holdings (CNTN) plans to have its common stock trade as a tokenized security on TSV LLC, a Canton Network venue, as early as November 2, using SEC-registered on-chain transfer agent Fairmint and operating under the SEC's five-year innovation exemption with 24/7 trading and atomic settlement.
current_state.en: Canton Strategic Holdings (CNTN) plans to have its common stock trade as a tokenized security on TSV LLC, a Canton Network venue, as early as November 2, using SEC-registered on-chain transfer agent Fairmint and operating under the SEC's five-year innovation exemption with 24/7 trading and atomic settlement.
